g.text: Opus leads · Grok executes and challenges · ChatGPT by agent preference
REQUIRED PROJECT DELIVERY · Opus owns the whole; workers own bounded changes
CALLABLE LEVERAGE LOOP · only on explicit request · 5-10× is a target to test
Allocation is flexible; subscription spend is fixed.
Medium by default; raise for difficulty
Use the model exposed by the account
Only when the agent prefers it
Task · file ownership · interface · acceptance checks · budget
Workers return changes + commands + results + unresolved risks
Resolve cross-stream contracts · review evidence · verify the outcome
High for difficult work; highest effort only for unresolved hard decisions
Keep critical decisions and final integration with Opus. Send independent, well-scoped work to Grok.
Use ChatGPT only for a concrete capability, tool fit or alternate perspective the agent prefers.
At limits: checkpoint and redistribute eligible work; preserve Opus capacity for integration.
Rebalance by accepted output, rework and remaining limits, not by matching subscription dollars.
Claude Opus 5.5 · Sonnet 5.5 · SuperGrok (model-agnostic) · ChatGPT available models.
Use subscription-supported surfaces. API billing and unattended cross-provider routing are not assumed.
